  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_init","line":480,"var":"card->reader->atr_info.hist_bytes","code":"pgp_get_card_features(card);","note":"Card initialization reads the attacker-controlled ATR historical bytes and uses them to derive OpenPGP card features.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"ATR historical bytes"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_get_card_features","line":781,"var":"blob73","code":"if ((pgp_get_blob(card, blob6e, 0x0073, &blob73) >= 0)) { ... }","note":"The feature parser walks the constructed DO tree and reaches the algorithm-attributes data objects under 006E/0073.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"feature discovery"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob","line":724,"var":"oid.value[j]","code":"for (j=0; j < (blob->len-1); j++) { oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1]; }","note":"For ECDH/ECDSA attributes, the code copies blob->len-1 bytes into a fixed-size OID buffer without bounding j to the destination size.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"algorithm attributes blob"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-openpgp.c","function":"pgp_parse_algo_attr_blob","line":724,"var":"oid.value[j]","code":"oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1];","note":"A long attacker-controlled algorithm-attributes blob overflows the stack OID buffer, causing the ASAN stack-buffer-overflow write in the reported sink.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"unchecked copy"}]}
]
